findings.summary: check_run_coherence groups on (agent, run_id), omitting stage and slug; a reused run_id merges independent runs and fabricates duplicate-pass / multiple-terminal reports
Coherence checker omits stage from the identity; rows from different stages sharing a run id are merged
Glob rescope concatenates every delta doc, so a stale document satisfies ADR-010 / ratchet-name / direction / per-key attribution on behalf of a new one containing none of them
Concatenating all delta docs lets a stale document satisfy gates the current one fails; only the aggregate assertion still reads the baseline
Four of six assertions weakened from per-document to corpus-wide and are now vacuous

Before/delta figures are two baseline generations stale (361396/295916 vs actual 362419/295582); the asymmetry narrative explains a copy error, and 'No round-trip count changed' is false while configure went 3->4

check_run_coherence falsely flags the mandated retry-after-launch-failure shape: the schema forces sentinels terminal while plan.md.j2 mandates a retry, and sentinels are excluded from the pass sequence, so every arrangement is flagged
One malformed row raises and voids the whole report; terminal is a truthiness test so the string 'false' counts as terminal
check_run_coherence has no caller — no CLI subcommand, no rendered guidance — while its docstring says 'Run this before any aggregation'
Guidance interpolates free text into a shell line's quotes; the double-quoted launch-error variant leaves $(...) and backticks live on text the model did not author
--slug {slug} and --run-id <run-id> are unquoted in the emit command the agent executes; same sink in execute.md.j2
The amendment's 'conservative direction' claim is statistically inverted: the admitted row was known-agreeing, so 0/2 -> 0/3 strengthens the deletion case rather than raising its bar
Same as above, raised independently and named as false in the direction that flatters the amendment
The dispatch count is computed from an independent source and then never compared to the emit count; a second dispatch with no ledger write still passes
expected dispatch count computed then discarded
Rendered guidance states the terminal invariant as global per run-id; the real identity is (agent, stage, slug, run-id), so another stage's terminal row could make the model drop its own
verifier_kept_n / verifier_dropped_n still documented as non-nullable int
